en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

I don't feel like seeing any more dead 
bodies... Even if they're fictional.

Sorry, but I'm not really into 
this kind of movie...

All the parts where you're supposed to 
laugh? I...don't really get those parts.

If we watch it together, you'll just 
worry if I'm enjoying it or not.

It's pretty plain, though. Real tennis 
is much more intense than this.

<CLT=cltMIND>...I think that's just because
you play at such an insane level...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Ryoma looks deep in thought...
